answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the karst bond on all of them and exposing each to the terrace slash. Because the forge audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Honest users pay that once, farms 6 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
